slot_note: Re-root of task124 in the same objective (Forecasting & Predictive Modeling). Architecture 1, the Texas retail electricity provider's summer firm-capacity block split (harden loops 0 to 2, carried in lineage as v1 to v3), is spent: a validated decoy the guard now blocks, two in-house solves on the default path, and two hardenings that stacked rungs above solved steps. Architecture 2 draws a new world, a new domain and a new decisive step; nothing of architecture 1's pack, prompt or asks is reused.
niche: a regional water district owned by its member municipalities, testing whether its lead service line replacement plan's annual capital finishes every zone by the federal deadline, and in which year each zone finishes, when the cost of each zone turns on how many of its unknown-material service lines prove to be lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement and nearly every field verification so far was prompted by evidence of lead
stakeholder_role: the district's lead service line programme manager, who brings the replacement schedule to the board with the capital plan

spine.entity: one service line (the connection from a water main to one premise) in the authority's lead and copper inventory, with its records, its classification and the main segment it taps
spine.source: synthetic, shaped on public lead service line inventories filed by Ohio community water systems

world.geography: United States, Ohio (fictional authority, city, townships and zones)
world.org_type: a regional water district owned by a mid-size Ohio city and two townships, serving about 88,000 service connections

driver: A rate measured on units that were examined because they showed signs of the outcome is carried to a population every unit of which will be examined; only the groups examined exhaustively, recognisable by complete coverage rather than by any code, give the population's rate within each visible stratum, and every pooling, stratification, reweighting or model fitted on the full set of examinations keeps the selection.
driver_concrete: Hollins Ford Regional Water District's plan digs every unknown-material service line in each zone it works, in priority order at a fixed capital a year, but nearly all of its 2021 to 2026 field verifications were prompted by a customer's report, a sampling site or a leak on old pipe, so the share found lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement in each construction era runs far above what a systematic dig finds; only the water-main segments whose every service was verified when the main was replaced show the shares the programme will meet, and with them every zone finishes before the deadline instead of after it.
stump: A competent solver joins the verification log to the inventory through the migration crosswalk, keeps the lines that had no material record, takes the share found lead or GRR in each construction era across every verification and prices each zone's unknown lines at it, so the zones' cumulative cost outruns the annual capital and the last zone finishes after the deadline; the step that lands it there is treating verifications prompted by evidence of lead as a sample of the lines a systematic programme digs, when only the segments a main replacement verified whole show the shares the programme will meet, and with them the last zone finishes before the deadline.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins the verification log through the migration crosswalk, normalises every material code, keeps the lines that had no material record and reads the inventory, the plan, the bid prices and the capital plan correctly still estimates each era's lead and GRR share from every verification on file (pooled, by era, or with a model on every visible attribute) and finds the plan misses the deadline, because nearly every verification was prompted by evidence of lead and only the segments a main replacement verified whole show what a programme that digs every unknown line will find.
domain_test: What decides the call is a water utility's estimate of how many of its unknown-material service lines are lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement, which inventory practice has to make from verifications that sampled lines regardless of their likely material, since a dig prompted by a customer's report, a sampling site or a leak on galvanized pipe finds lead far more often than a systematic dig; with another field's nouns there are no tap cards, goosenecks, GRR classifications or main-replacement sweeps, and the task does not read the same.
layer1: a field verification log keyed by the customer system's legacy premise number before the March 2023 GIS migration and by the GIS service line id after it, joined through the migration crosswalk
material result codes that differ by crew and contractor form (PB, LEAD; GALV-RR, GRR; CU, COPPER, PE, NL), resolved through the field code list
re-verifications of one line (a pothole, then an excavation) dated in two formats either side of the migration
the county assessor's year built carried onto the inventory, zero or blank on non-residential parcels
a contractor pay-application export at site-line grain that repeats each change order's total on every covered site's line
pay applications revised and resubmitted, with the engineer's decisions kept in a separate review log
property access agreements keyed by the legacy premise number before the migration and carrying the zone named on the form when it was signed
one owner's agreement signed twice, on paper and on the customer portal

notes: Architecture 2 of task124, drawn 2026-10-12 at the wave-1 resume. Forecasting: the call is a bet on what the plan's digs will find zone by zone over 2027 to 2037, and the history pins it only through the verifications a programme-like process produced. Pattern none, G14 decisive (the verified yield, conditioned on why a line was dug, does not apply to a programme that digs every line), G6 (the zones' construction-era mix differs from the swept segments') and G2 (the representative unit is a main segment verified whole, built by grouping verifications by segment against the inventory, no key bridging them); as on task183, no A to E pattern label is carried. Strategy population_selection: the measured rate comes from units selected on signs of the outcome. Calibration physical_verification: the field verification log. No decoy document, no voice, no certified figure pins the method; the estimand is filed literally and the design forces the method. Furniture drawn clear of task181 v4 and task229, both filed today and later in draw order (role, artifact, organisation family, forum, forcing event, shape and decisive mechanism), so this card bans neither.
